detail: IPUMS Los Angeles 1999 PUMS: matched columns farm and school are binary individual attributes (farm status, school attendance); the flattened household+individual table has no household/cluster id column, so no grouping unit observations repeat within.

World Happiness 2015: one row per country; matched column Family is a happiness-score component (social-support contribution), a predictor not a clustering unit.

Student grade pass/fail (Cortez & Silva Math, dipam7 variant): matched column school has two levels (GP/MS) modelled as a fixed binary attribute in the classification/regression task, not a sampled clustering unit.

OECD worldwide crop production: matched column SUBJECT is a crop-type attribute; the table is aggregate country-year national statistics in long format with VALUE pooling several measures, not observations repeating within a clustering unit.
